gates.name: activity_evidence_depth
gates.target: >=250 unique activity molecules for curated-grade; >=50 for useful starter
gates.recommendation: Pull ChEMBL/PubChem/HF activity sources or add more CleanMol-extracted papers.

gates.name: toxicity_selectivity_depth
gates.recommendation: Enable Tox21/ToxCast/ChAFF-style sources or upload hemolysis/cytotoxicity data.

gates.name: label_density
gates.recommendation: Prefer measured endpoints over unlabeled SMILES-only corpora.

gates.name: source_diversity
gates.recommendation: Combine uploaded data, CleanMol literature extraction, ChEMBL/PubChem, and HF safety sources.

gates.name: modern_source_presence
gates.recommendation: Use the Source Library and avoid relying on one old benchmark.

gates.name: organism_or_assay_breadth
gates.target: >=3 organism/assay groups, ideally Gram-positive, Gram-negative, fungal/biofilm
gates.recommendation: Add papers or assays spanning multiple organisms and surface/formulation conditions.

gates.name: modern_seed_depth
gates.recommendation: Extract more QAC/biocide papers or pull modern cationic/amphiphilic source data.

gates.name: scaffold_diversity
gates.recommendation: Avoid a one-family QAC-only dataset; include phosphonium, pyridinium, imidazolium, gemini/bis variants, and safety negatives.

gates.name: synthetic_prior_separation
gates.recommendation: Keep synthetic priors separate and add measured/public experimental rows before calling the dataset curated-grade.

gates.name: candidate_quality
gates.target: >=80% of top 20 candidates modern_seed and >=20 ranked candidates
gates.recommendation: Tighten generation filters or increase modern seed diversity.

recommendations: Pull ChEMBL/PubChem/HF activity sources or add more CleanMol-extracted papers.

Prefer measured endpoints over unlabeled SMILES-only corpora.

equalizer_note: The same quality gates are applied to uploaded and auto-created datasets. Synthetic/model-prior rows can help start discovery but cannot by themselves make a dataset curated-grade.
